gaps.quote: A row addition on fields of $u=f\Omega$ bits costs $O(V(u^\tau+1))$.
gaps.note: Stated as the cost of the outside work with no citation and no argument. The only cited bound is for an address interchange, and the page does not say how it yields this row-addition cost. Tape-level data movement is outside the reader's profile, so the reader cannot check it.
Presented as following from the fixed value of theta, but theta = 1/2 alone gives no bound on d in terms of f. The page cites nothing for it, so the reader cannot see where it comes from.

gaps.quote: Taking $\lambda$ with $\log_m(s/W)<\lambda<1$ makes the ratio below 1
gaps.note: The outside-work bound needed lambda > tau(1+eta/theta). The page never imposes this on the chosen lambda and never shows that a lambda meeting both constraints exists, so the reader cannot check that the internal-sum argument and the outside-work bound use the same lambda.

Using the page's own d at most f^(1/theta), the leaf bound gives only O(f^sigma times f^(1-sigma)) = O(f), which is not O(f^lambda) because lambda < 1. Nothing on the page supplies the missing inequality, so this final step does not follow from what the page gives.
